seoTitle: Web Font Loading Snippet Generator: @font-face, font-display, Preload
metaDescription: Describe your font files and get @font-face rules with font-display, WOFF2-first src lists, preload tags and a fallback font stack.
intro: Writes @font-face rules, preload tags and a font stack from a list of your font files.
why:
Web fonts can block or shift text. Good loading code is short but easy to get wrong.

The tool orders WOFF2 first, adds format hints, sets font-display, and preloads the first faces you choose with crossorigin. It explains what the chosen font-display value does. It does not check licenses or subset the file; use the Font Subsetter for size.
howTo: Add one line per face: Family | weight | style | files.
Pick font-display and how many faces to preload.
Copy the CSS and head tags.

faq.a: swap shows text at once and swaps later; optional avoids layout shift but may keep the fallback. Avoid block for body text.

faq.q: Do I need WOFF as well as WOFF2?
faq.a: Only for very old browsers. WOFF2 is supported everywhere current.
Each preload competes for bandwidth. Preload faces used above the fold.
